acceptance: Cosmetic, additive, breaking, permission and unknown semantic changes produce different diff classes with stable ordering.

positive.fixture: each family's change table yields the expected class and path; symmetric add and remove

negative.fixture: duplicate keys and unclassified shapes are unknown; family mismatch and unsupported families are refused

security_and_source_permissions: Any effect, authorization or action-binding change is a permission change.
known_limitations: Observation and environment diffs are unsupported
